limits: All sources, checkpoints and prediction hashes froze before scoring; chronology is not an operating-system access audit.
Consumed natural development and old failures motivated the change. Fresh complete analytic configurations remain within the same noiseless generator family.
The revised pipeline has frozen weights and original natural-TRAIN scaling; no claim that its selector is optimal for the changed candidate distribution.
Only the full40 peak path is recomputed against the original feature cache; other unchanged feature channels are copied and hash-bound.
Coverage gains and eviction losses are separately reported. The unchanged grouping-loss gate is not a gate on policy-eviction losses.
All twelve fresh cases also pass under the original policy, so they establish retention within these cases, not superiority.
Prior browser timing and reserved-speaker results do not qualify this offline policy. No calibration, external-speech or clinical claim.
Raw audio, generated PCM, references, features, checkpoints and natural per-frame predictions remain local and ignored.
